test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

My son exclaimed with joy that it was an attractive site.

options.text: My son said, “It is an attractive site.”
My son said, “What an attractive site it is!”
My son said, “What an attractive site it was!”
My son said, “It was an attractive site.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **My son said, “What an attractive site it is!”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Direct speech requires the use of quotation marks and the reporting verb '**said**'.
 
• The tense of the reported speech changes to the present form.
 
• The pronouns may change depending on the context of the reported speech.
 
• In this case, the reported speech is a statement and not a question or command.
 
• In the direct speech transformation, the introductory phrase changes from "**My son exclaimed with joy**" to "**My son said.**"
 
• The main statement within the quotation marks is **directly quoted**, and it maintains the son's exact expression.
 
• Quotation marks indicate direct speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: Incorrect as it changes the meaning of the original sentence by adding emphasis and making it sound like a rhetorical question.
 
• **Option 3**: Incorrect as it changes the tense of the reported speech to past, which is not accurate.
 
• **Option 4**: Also incorrect as it changes the word order and does not convey the same level of excitement as the original sentence.
